items.summary: A North York man says he was shocked to get insurance documents in the mail for the purchase of his new truck. The only problem? He didn’t buy one.

items.title: Second-hand luxury stores in Hong Kong probed over HK$16.6m payment defaults
items.summary: Hong Kong police are investigating two second-hand luxury goods shops in connection with more than 40 complaints of suspected fraud totalling HK$16.6 million (US$2.11 million). Vootic in Causeway Bay and Obsessplanet in Admiralty were closed abruptly on Tuesday.
